description: This file defines API endpoints for session management within a web backend, utilizing FastAPI. It includes routes for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting sessions, and posting messages associated with sessions, interfacing with a database via Supabase. It also employs dependency injection for user authentication and enforces access controls using RLS policies.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client configured with environment variables. Used internally by route handlers to access the database.

methods.name: list_sessions(user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sessions belonging to the authenticated user, ordered by creation date.

methods.name: create_session(payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Creates a new session for the authenticated user, handling insertion and potential errors related to database permissions.

methods.name: get_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Fetches a specific session by ID along with its messages, ensuring ownership.

methods.name: update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Partially updates a session's metadata, primarily the title, with fallback retrieval if update fails.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Deletes a session owned by the user.

methods.name: post_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Posts a user message within a session after verifying session ownership and presence of at least one uploaded file. Creates an assistant stub reply.
